name: card_not_present_fraud

trigger.description: Card-not-present fraud detected on ACC-10023. Customer's debit card used for 7 online purchases totaling $3,847.50 across e-commerce merchants in a 2-hour window. Customer confirms they did not make these purchases. Card data likely compromised via skimming or data breach.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: detect fraud pattern, investigate card compromise source, freeze card and issue replacement, initiate chargebacks for all 7 transactions, file report.

reads.query: retrieve transaction history for ACC-10023 card ending 4491 over the last 30 days
fraud rule engine alerts and velocity checks triggered for ACC-10023
known fraud patterns for card-not-present transactions at merchants ElectroMart Online, LuxWatch Direct, TechGadgets Pro
card freeze and replacement procedures for compromised debit cards
prior CNP fraud cases and chargeback success rates for similar merchant categories

writes.content: Fraud investigation FRD-2026-0701: Card-not-present fraud confirmed on ACC-10023. 7 unauthorized transactions totaling $3,847.50 across e-commerce merchants. Customer confirmed non-authorization. Card data likely compromised via prior data breach.
Risk assessment: ACC-10023 card ending 4491 compromised. All 7 transactions flagged for chargeback. No additional account products affected. Customer identity verified via security questions.
Remediation: Card ending 4491 frozen and marked for replacement. Provisional credits issued for all 7 transactions ($3,847.50 total). Chargeback cases filed with acquiring banks.
Case report FRD-2026-0701: CNP fraud resolved. Card replaced, provisional credits issued, 7 chargebacks filed. Total exposure $3,847.50. Customer notified and account monitoring enhanced for 90 days.

name: wire_fraud_bec

trigger.description: Business Email Compromise (BEC) wire fraud reported by commercial customer. Controller at Apex Manufacturing (ACC-10067) received spoofed email appearing to be from the company CFO instructing a $187,500 wire transfer to 'new vendor' account at overseas bank. Wire was executed 2 hours ago and funds have not yet settled at beneficiary bank.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: verify fraud, initiate immediate wire recall via SWIFT MT192, freeze outbound wires on account, investigate email compromise, file SAR, generate report.

reads.query: retrieve wire transfer history for ACC-10067 and verify beneficiary Global Supply Partners FZE is not a known vendor
BEC fraud alerts and email domain verification results for apex-manufacturing.co vs apex-manufacturing.com
prior BEC wire fraud cases involving Middle East beneficiary banks and similar spoofed domain patterns
SWIFT MT192 wire recall procedures and beneficiary bank contact protocols for Emirates NBD
BEC wire fraud recovery rates and SAR filing requirements for international wire transfers over $100,000

writes.content: Fraud investigation FRD-2026-0702: BEC wire fraud confirmed. $187,500 wire to Emirates NBD account AE070331234567890123456 initiated via spoofed CFO email from apex-manufacturing.co. Wire executed 2 hours ago, funds not yet settled.

Risk assessment: Time-critical wire recall needed. Beneficiary bank Emirates NBD contacted via SWIFT MT192. Probability of recovery estimated 60-70% given 2-hour window. All outbound wires on ACC-10067 frozen pending investigation.

Remediation: SWIFT MT192 recall message sent for WIRE-20260409-067. Outbound wire capability suspended on ACC-10067. SAR filed with FinCEN (reference SAR-2026-0702). Law enforcement notification prepared.

Case report FRD-2026-0702: BEC wire fraud — $187,500 recall initiated via SWIFT MT192. SAR filed. Customer advised of investigation timeline. Wire freeze in place on commercial account. Awaiting beneficiary bank response.

writes.content: AML investigation FRD-2026-0703: Structuring confirmed on ACC-10042 (Viktor Petrov). 8 cash deposits totaling $74,200 over 3 days across 5 branches, all below $10,000 CTR threshold. Customer has 1 prior SAR on file.

name: check_kiting_scheme

trigger.description: Check kiting pattern detected between two accounts held at our institution. ACC-10034 and ACC-10035 (both owned by Coastal Ventures LLC) are exchanging checks in a circular pattern, artificially inflating balances. Over the past 10 days, 14 checks totaling $156,000 have been exchanged between the accounts. Both accounts show negative collected balances but positive ledger balances due to float exploitation.

expected_behavior: Full pipeline: confirm kiting pattern via transaction analysis, investigate business legitimacy, place hold on both accounts, process chargebacks for uncollected items, file SAR, compile audit report.

reads.query: retrieve check clearing history and ledger vs collected balances for ACC-10034 and ACC-10035 over the past 15 days
overdraft monitoring alerts and float exploitation flags for Coastal Ventures LLC accounts
check kiting detection patterns including circular check exchange and negative collected balance indicators
check kiting hold procedures and chargeback processing for uncollected items across linked accounts
prior check kiting case outcomes and loss recovery rates for commercial accounts

writes.content: Fraud investigation FRD-2026-0705: Check kiting confirmed between ACC-10034 and ACC-10035 (Coastal Ventures LLC). 14 circular checks totaling $156,000 over 10 days. Both accounts show negative collected balances (ACC-10034: -$42,300; ACC-10035: -$38,700).

Risk assessment: Coastal Ventures LLC exploiting check float across two accounts. Combined uncollected deficit $81,000. Business legitimacy unverified. Risk of total loss if accounts are not frozen immediately.

Remediation: Both ACC-10034 and ACC-10035 placed on administrative hold. Uncollected items returned. SAR filed with FinCEN (reference SAR-2026-0705). Customer notified of account restrictions and investigation.

Case report FRD-2026-0705: Check kiting scheme resolved. Both accounts frozen, uncollected items charged back. Total exposure $81,000 in uncollected balances. SAR filed. Account closure proceedings initiated.
